flags.why: Everyday Vietnamese also uses phá for causing trouble or disrupting something without destroying it.
flags.fix: Add a verb sense: to cause trouble; to disrupt. Example: Đừng phá nữa, để mẹ làm việc. = Stop causing trouble and let Mom work.

flags.why: Quả for wedding gift boxes, as in bưng quả, is mainly Southern usage, not Northern.
flags.fix: Replace Northern with Southern; retain uncommon.
